preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 20000.
For each test case, the number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100000, and the maximum sum S must be between 1 and 10^16.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n and 1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= w_i <= 1000000 and 1 <= c_i <= 2 for v_i, u_i, w_i, c_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect valid vertices, have a weight between 1 and 1000000, and a cost of either 1 or 2.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum total cost required to make the sum of weights of paths from the root to each leaf at most S.
